prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need SEO, PPC, social, content, web design, branding, or a full-service partner.

If you want, I can find and recommend specific agencies; to give a useful shortlist, tell me:
- Primary goals (lead gen, ecommerce revenue, brand awareness, retention, etc.)
- Top channels you want (SEO, Google/Facebook ads, social, email, content, web)
- Budget range (monthly or campaign)
- Company size and industry (B2B or B2C)
- Timeline and whether you prefer a local in-person agency or are OK remote

How to choose an agency (quick checklist)
- Relevant experience: case studies in your industry or with similar goals
- Measurable results: KPIs, before/after metrics, client references
- Services and team: in-house specialists vs contractors
- Transparency: reporting cadence, tools, contract terms, fees
- Culture and communication: fit on strategy and communication style
- Technical capability: website platform, analytics, tracking, tag management
- Reviews and credentials: Clutch, Google reviews, awards, LinkedIn recommendations

Questions to ask agencies in an initial call
1. Can you show specific case studies and outcomes for clients like us?
2. What KPIs would you prioritize and how do you report progress?
3. Who on your team will work on our account and what are their backgrounds?
4. What is your onboarding process and expected timeline to see results?
5. How do you handle budgets, ad spend, and additional costs?
6. Can you provide references I can contact?

Where I recommend looking for local options
- Clutch.co or UpCity (agency reviews and filters)
- Google Maps / Google Business listings and reviews
- LinkedIn (agency pages and employee bios)
- St. Louis Business Journal or local award lists

If you want, I’ll:
- pull a 3–5 agency shortlist tailored to your needs and budget, or
- compare 2–3 agencies you’re considering

Which would you prefer?
